access.account_lost.name: Account hacked or lost
access.account_lost.description: Reviewers report their accounts were hacked or taken over, leaving them locked out and unable to get support help.

access.general.name: App won't open or work
access.general.description: Reviewers say the app won't open or function even after reinstalling, clearing data, or resetting their phone.

access.logged_out.name: Unexpected logouts and freezes
access.logged_out.description: Reviewers report being logged out unexpectedly, after which the app gets stuck on the logo or a loading screen.

access.login_failure.name: Cannot log in
access.login_failure.description: Reviewers cannot sign in with their email, password, or Facebook login, even with premium accounts.

billing.charges_refund.name: Unfair charges and payment prompts
billing.charges_refund.description: Reviewers feel pressured to pay, with aggressive payment reminders and charges they see as unfair or forced.

billing.general.name: Paid features feel unfair
billing.general.description: Reviewers object to features moved behind a paywall, feeling the free service has become less useful.

billing.premium_paywall.name: Basic features locked behind premium
billing.premium_paywall.description: Reviewers are frustrated that basic controls like shuffle, skip, and replay require a premium subscription.

billing.price.name: Subscription too expensive
billing.price.description: Reviewers say the premium subscription costs too much and some say they may cancel because of it.

billing.subscription_entitlement.name: Ads and features tied to premium
billing.subscription_entitlement.description: Reviewers complain that ads persist for free users or that favourite songs and features stop working without premium.

catalog.general.name: Limited or unwanted songs
catalog.general.description: Reviewers feel the song selection is limited and that songs they did not choose appear in their playlists.

catalog.lyrics.name: Lyrics missing or not loading
catalog.lyrics.description: Reviewers report lyrics no longer appear or fail to load, and some feel removing them was unnecessary.

catalog.missing_content.name: Songs and features removed
catalog.missing_content.description: Reviewers notice songs disappearing from the catalogue, some regional features restricted, and playlist songs they cannot find.

catalog.podcasts.name: Podcast and audiobook problems
catalog.podcasts.description: Reviewers report podcasts in the wrong language, unfollowed shows still appearing, and disappointment with audiobooks.

catalog.recommendations.name: Unwanted recommended songs
catalog.recommendations.description: Reviewers say the app adds random recommended songs to playlists and repeats songs they do not want to hear.

catalog.search.name: Hard to find wanted songs
catalog.search.description: Reviewers find search returns the wrong songs, artists are hard to find, and their own lists are difficult to locate.

downloads.download_failure.name: Downloads fail or stop playing
downloads.download_failure.description: Reviewers report downloads failing on new phones or previously downloaded songs not playing after restarts.

downloads.downloads_lost.name: Downloaded songs deleted
downloads.downloads_lost.description: Reviewers say many of their downloaded songs were removed, sometimes after updates, and cannot be moved to storage.

downloads.general.name: Local and personal files missing
downloads.general.description: Reviewers say songs and personal lists fail to appear or play without Wi-Fi, and local files do not show up.

downloads.offline_play.name: Offline listening broken
downloads.offline_play.description: Reviewers report offline playback failing, premium benefits not working offline, and downloads cleared without consent.

other.general_dislike.name: General dissatisfaction with app
other.general_dislike.description: Reviewers express broad dislike of the app or recent updates, often without describing a specific problem.

playback.audio_quality.name: Poor sound quality
playback.audio_quality.description: Reviewers say the audio sounds poor, songs cut off on mobile, and quality drops after recent updates.

playback.battery_resource.name: Battery and data drain
playback.battery_resource.description: Reviewers say the app runs in the background, drains battery, and uses a lot of data.

playback.connectivity.name: Connection and car audio issues
playback.connectivity.description: Reviewers get false no-internet messages, slow performance, and trouble connecting the app to car audio systems.

playback.crash_freeze.name: App crashes or freezes
playback.crash_freeze.description: Reviewers report the app closing unexpectedly, freezing, or refusing to pause or stop playback.

playback.general.name: Playback not working properly
playback.general.description: Reviewers say playback stops working, the app does not stay active in the background, and some features are unsupported.

playback.lag_loading.name: Slow loading and lag
playback.lag_loading.description: Reviewers report the app lagging, taking a long time to load songs, and glitching even with premium.

playback.song_choice_restricted.name: Wrong song plays
playback.song_choice_restricted.description: Reviewers say tapping a favourite song plays a different one, and the app stutters or glitches during playback.

playback.stops_pauses.name: Music stops unexpectedly
playback.stops_pauses.description: Reviewers report songs stopping on their own, playlists halting after one track, and errors persisting after updates.

support.general.name: Poor support and survey annoyance
support.general.description: Reviewers feel the company does not respond to feedback and that surveys and premium prompts are intrusive.

support.support_response.name: Customer support unhelpful
support.support_response.description: Reviewers say chat support takes too long, rarely solves problems, and offers no direct customer service options.

usability.ads.name: Too many ads
usability.ads.description: Reviewers complain of frequent ads, including back-to-back ads during songs, making the app frustrating to use.

usability.general.name: Basic controls and privacy concerns
usability.general.description: Reviewers report missing basic controls like rewind and sharing, lost search history, and feeling their privacy was breached.

usability.playlist_library.name: Playlists and liked songs hard to use
usability.playlist_library.description: Reviewers say liked songs display blank, playlists play only suggestions, and the like button is harder to find.

usability.shuffle_queue.name: Can't control song order
usability.shuffle_queue.description: Reviewers feel unable to skip, unshuffle, or play songs in their chosen order, with unwanted songs auto-playing.

usability.ui_layout.name: Layout changes disliked
usability.ui_layout.description: Reviewers want recent home page and interface changes reverted, including the missing history, heart button, and canvas features.
